industries.name: 锦样分授
industries.description: 锦户把织样分成数份，交给城中的织工。各坊仍织原有的布匹，只拨出少量丝线依样绣作；新学的针法，由讲习院按期校验。
industries.description_english: Brocade households distribute copies of their patterns among the town's weavers. Each workshop keeps its usual cloth production, setting aside a little silk for embroidery. The brocade school checks the work against the master patterns.

industries.name: 井灶合煎
industries.description: 旧盐场依常法出盐，井户另领木料与铁器，择卤分锅精煎。几家共用的灶具记入一册，精盐单独过秤，日常盐课仍照旧交纳。
industries.description_english: The saltworks keep their ordinary production while experienced well households refine a smaller batch in separate pans. Shared equipment is entered in one ledger, and the refined salt is weighed apart from the usual salt dues.

industries.name: 槽帘传习
industries.description: 老纸匠把细帘的编法留给各坊，先教选料，再教看浆。坊中的常纸照旧出槽，细料另留一份，抄成适合书契与印行的蜀纸。
industries.description_english: Master papermakers teach the workshops how to weave finer screens, choose their fibers and judge the pulp. Ordinary paper continues to leave the vats, while a small share of selected material becomes Shu paper for contracts and printing.

industries.name: 茶引分庄
industries.description: 交割场把验茶、压砖与包扎的规矩分给沿途集镇。各镇照做原有手艺，逢茶到市，再按同一分量压砖封包，交给过山的商队。
industries.description_english: The tea exchange passes its rules for sorting, pressing and wrapping tea to the villages along the route. Their usual crafts continue; when tea reaches the market, a small batch is pressed and packed to standard weights for the mountain caravans.
